about_short_description.short_description: Cleargrid is a fintech platform providing credit infrastructure, risk assessment, and debt collection solutions for businesses.

product.name: AI-Powered Outreach
product.description: An AI-driven system that personalizes communication by selecting the right message, channel, and timing to improve response rates in debt collection.

product.name: Flexible Settlements
product.description: A service that automates negotiation and allows customers to set up flexible repayment plans to facilitate debt settlement.

product.name: Real-Time Data Insights
product.description: A dashboard and analytics tool providing live tracking of engagement, performance, and debtor behavior during the collections process.

product.name: Advanced Skip Tracing
product.description: A data aggregation tool that locates hard-to-reach debtors by consolidating information from multiple sources.

product.name: AURA Risk Assessment
product.description: An AI-based risk assessment tool that identifies high-risk accounts to prioritize resource allocation in collections.

product.name: ClearAI Voice Agents
product.description: AI-driven voice agents that conduct natural, empathetic conversations with debtors to improve repayment outcomes.
